strings.list2.title: بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم
strings.list2.lead: تاریخی سوق القیصریہ سے لے کر نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں تک: خریداری کریں، چہل قدمی کریں اور الاحساء کی نعمتیں چکھیں۔

notes.text: Approved tm.json pair reused verbatim: the English 'Souqs, Parks & Farms' recurs exactly from nav.leisure («بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم»; RUNBOOK 3, DECISIONS b12-ui). The h1 and tab title therefore equal the header label the reader sees on the same page, and agree with the crumb crumb.leisure «بازار اور تفریح گاہیں» (the crumb is a shorter form of the same words; no contradiction). «زرعی فارم» is ruling N5's qualified form for the word standing in a label or heading; no final stop (heading); no bracket (P3c-labels). Not reopened.

Approved tm.json pair reused verbatim: the English 'Visit guide' recurs exactly from list.eyebrow («سیاحتی رہنما»), the eyebrow of the sister attractions index. The ru/de/zh precedent likewise give both indexes the same eyebrow. No final stop.

New sentence. Built as a sister of the approved list.lead («غاروں سے بھرے پہاڑ سے لے کر خلیج کے کنارے کی بندرگاہ تک: کوئی زمرہ چنیں اور سیر شروع کریں۔»): the same «… سے لے کر … تک:» frame, the source's em dash rendered as the colon the sister uses (role file: the dash is not a default Urdu device), then honorific imperatives. Names: «سوق القیصریہ» byte for byte the termbase key and the approved title of the qaisariyah page; the English shortens it to 'the Qaisariyah' and the Arabic to «القيصرية»; the full key is written, as approved cat.market.d does where the English shortens it, and the name stands bare (P3c-labels: the lead is also the meta description, where no gloss is possible; no Urdu generic beside it). «الاحساء» head name (P2) with the Urdu possessive (P8; N115: no adjective coined).

Word choices. 'storied' / AR «العريقة» → «تاریخی» (historic, long-established): not a superlative, nothing added; it is the press's own epithet for this market (urdunews.com/node/599631 headline «الاحسا کا تاریخی بازار ’سوق القیصریہ‘», quoted in the termbase entry). The approved qaisariyah faq[4].a renders 'most storied' as «مشہور ترین», a superlative this sentence does not carry, so not reused. 'oasis' → «نخلستان» (termbase generic; AR «حدائق الواحة ومزارعها» = the oasis's gardens and its farms, both governed by «نخلستان کے»). 'gardens' → «باغوں» (entry «باغ»; a garden, not «تفریح گاہ», which is the parks key). 'farms' → «فارموں», the oblique plural of the entry «فارم» as approved running text writes it («سب سے بڑے فارموں میں سے ایک»); N5's qualifier «زرعی» is owed where the word stands alone in a label — here it stands in a sentence beside «باغوں» and «نخلستان». Alternative recorded in case a reader takes it for 'forms': «نخلستان کے باغوں اور زرعی فارموں تک». 'shop' → «خریداری کریں»; 'stroll' → «چہل قدمی کریں» (a leisurely walk; «سیر کریں» possible too, but the sister lead already closes on «سیر»); 'taste the bounty of Al-Ahsa' / AR «ذُق خيرات الأحساء» → «الاحساء کی نعمتیں چکھیں» (taste Al-Ahsa's good things; «مزہ چکھنا» avoided — idiomatically it means suffering the consequences). Final «۔» kept: the English ends with a stop and this is a sentence, not a heading.

Ruling N47 (a page that mentions the oasis names it at least once): the string says the bare «نخلستان» as the source says 'the oasis'. The rendered page already names the oasis in one of its cards on the trace build (_scratch/ui-trace-b12-ui/dist/ur/souqs-parks-farms/index.html: «الاحساء کے نخلستان کے ماحول میں ایک باغ،»), and the same sentence names Al-Ahsa at its close, so the bare noun is kept. But the lead is ALSO the meta description, read alone in a search snippet where the oasis is not named: for stage 4 to weigh. Alternative recorded, not written: «تاریخی سوق القیصریہ سے لے کر الاحساء کے نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں تک: خریداری کریں، چہل قدمی کریں اور یہاں کی نعمتیں چکھیں۔» (names the oasis; the closing 'Al-Ahsa' becomes 'here' to avoid the name twice — a change of the source's wording, which is why it is not the stage-1 text).

No open item of the termbase (P4, BRAND) is touched: no unconfirmed field, no brand in the three strings. No new name: «سوق القیصریہ», «الاحساء», «نخلستان», «باغ», «فارم», «تفریح گاہ», «بازار» are all termbase entries. No number, no placeholder, no Latin letter. Source check: English and Arabic agree on every fact of the three strings (Arabic 'the oasis's gardens and its farms', English 'the oasis gardens and farms'); no divergence to log.
